question: Should this PR land with read-scoped drift path visibility and a fresh disk snapshot read on cached health responses, or should the visibility/freshness policy be tightened first?
rationale: The patch is additive and well-tested, but tests cannot decide the product and operations tradeoff for auth-adjacent health visibility or cache-hit latency.

options.title: Accept Diagnostic Boundary
options.body: Land after exact-head merge validation because redaction is tested, the read-scoped output omits fingerprints and disk errors, and the proof shows the normal health path behavior.

options.title: Require Tighter Proof Or Scope
options.body: Ask for read-vs-admin output proof, a latency sample, or a narrower admin-only detail boundary before merge if the current visibility/IO tradeoff is not acceptable.

options.title: Pause For Restart Policy Pairing
options.body: Hold this PR only if maintainers decide the diagnostic must land together with the companion restart-policy PR.

recommendation.title: Accept Diagnostic Boundary
recommendation.body: Land after exact-head merge validation because redaction is tested, the read-scoped output omits fingerprints and disk errors, and the proof shows the normal health path behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice spans config runtime behavior and auth-adjacent diagnostic policy, where steipete has the strongest adjacent history among the identified people.
